crates/economy/chio-anchor/src/witness.r.contract: Opaque witness proof serialization and base64 decode have a 1 MiB decoded budget; encoded length is checked before allocating decoded proof bytes. Wire receipt shape remains unverified until the pinned lane verifier and batch bindings succeed.

crates/economy/chio-anchor/src/witness/r.contract: HTTP retention has a 4 MiB budget; nested original base64 JSON has a 1 MiB decoded budget and duplicate/loss-aware native projection. A single response entry, body hash, SET signature, optional Merkle proof and signed receipt timestamp are required. Shared fallible clock fences reject unavailable, future and regressing time; publication validates time before receipt custody. Native causes and HTTP failures have safe public diagnostics.

crates/economy/chio-credit/src/factor/mo.contract: Factor evidence uses original native typed canonical equality under a 4 MiB bound. Native input causes survive factor and IOU conversion; existing factor I-JSON monetary/time constraints, signatures, exact bindings and explicit trusted time remain.

crates/economy/chio-credit/src/financial.contract: Embedded source artifacts preserve the existing 512 KiB budget, now enforced at original native canonical parsing before typed projection. Existing collection, member completeness, signature and authenticated source-subject checks remain; parser causes are retained.

crates/economy/chio-credit/src/iou_v2.rs.contract: Native IOU canonical imports have a 4 MiB cap and exact typed original-byte equality with preserved body validation and native causes. Issuer, receipt and committed credit admission verification still determine authority.

crates/economy/chio-credit/src/obligatio.contract: Native signed facility-bind imports have a 4 MiB cap and exact typed canonical equality before body validation. Configured authority, debtor/creditor signatures, validity and semantic bindings remain mandatory; input causes survive.

Signed obligation status bytes have a 4 MiB native typed canonical contract. Original aliases and alternate encoding fail with a native source; trusted signer, status, digest and explicit-time verification remain separate.

crates/economy/chio-fiscal/src/fiscal.rs.contract: Charter and schedule original bytes use their existing 1 MiB native canonical bounds before verification. Body, signer, self identity, charter binding and predecessor lineage verification remain unchanged; local parsing causes are retained.

crates/economy/chio-fiscal/src/lifecycle.contract: Continuity bytes use the existing lifecycle bound and exact native typed canonical equality before genesis policy, charter, signature and checkpoint verification. Original parser causes survive.

Runtime registry and signed readiness use existing lifecycle bounds and exact native canonical bytes before registry and policy/readiness verification. Supported adapter shape, signer, digest and authority requirements remain; causes are preserved.

crates/economy/chio-link/src/chainlink.r.contract: Contract-backed HTTP bounds retention; original unsigned JSON rejects duplicates before Alloy RawValue projection of the same bytes, preserving native integers and ordinary float spellings. Native transport and parser causes survive the public oracle error; public errors never echo provider bodies. Chain, feed, configured decimals, round, price and freshness checks remain.

crates/economy/chio-listing/src/outcome/.contract: Outcome artifacts have a 4 MiB original strict external I-JSON canonical contract. Exact original-byte equality and native local parser causes precede typed projection; owner signature/digest/lifecycle checks remain.

Output JSON is bounded to 4 MiB before original strict I-JSON projection. Invalid input stays a closed Unevaluable verdict while the local evaluation retains its parser cause. Deterministic equality excludes diagnostic object identity; the exact original output digest is retained even for rejected output.

crates/economy/chio-market/src/parametri.contract: Signed policies retain their 1 MiB native typed canonical contract, now before policy signature and authority verification with preserved native cause. Coverage, currency, payout and trusted evidence registry validation remain.

crates/economy/chio-open-market/src/purc.contract: Original purchase members are bounded by the existing carrier limit and losslessly native-decoded before projection or canonical digest construction. Ignored nested duplicates cannot acquire a normalized identity. Configured finding, venue, seller, handshake, reservation and capability bindings remain mandatory.

crates/economy/chio-open-market/src/reco.contract: Recovery members preserve the existing strict external I-JSON and exact typed canonical contract under the carrier limit. Parser causes survive member/context/metadata projection. Original kernel receipt signature, purchase and capability identity, subject and recovery authority binding remain unchanged.

crates/economy/chio-settle/src/ccip.rs.contract: The only lexical decoder is a repository-owned include_str receipt fixture inside cfg(test). Production CCIP accepts typed validated receipts and checks lane, receipt, payload and replay identity. No redundant production parser introduced.

crates/economy/chio-settle/src/channel/r.contract: Replay pins and descriptors retain 256 KiB and 4 MiB native typed canonical bounds. Pins validate before authority use; descriptor reconstruction retains exact configured pins, signatures, economic state, proposal and reservation identity. Input causes remain native.

crates/economy/chio-settle/src/config.rs.contract: Local deployment files use a bounded actual read (1 MiB plus one sentinel byte), regular-file check and original lossless native JSON before closed typed projection. Native file and parser failures survive; chain and egress validation still own dispatch authority.

crates/economy/chio-settle/src/finding_e.contract: Observation responses retain their 64 KiB original strict external canonical contract with native causes. Bounds apply at the decoding owner for custom transports too. Schema, exact request digest, chain hashes, operator key epoch and finality shape validation remain.

Publisher responses now enforce the 1 MiB bound at the consumer, including alternate transports, before original strict external canonical projection. Native input causes survive; schema and exact request digest remain required. No failure manufactures a settlement outcome.

crates/economy/chio-settle/src/retry.rs.contract: Dead-letter custom Deserialize accepts only the closed typed reason schema and a nonzero attempt count. The legacy string-reason fallback is removed. Terminal reason digests remain bounded, and unsupported schema/unknown fields fail closed.
